purpose: Measure the risk-versus-autonomy-coverage frontier, uncertainty calibration, worst-family outcomes, abstention timeliness, fallback recoverability and compute cost for frozen driving decision records.
claim_ceiling: Offline statistics for exact declared records only. Not a safety monitor, action authorization, fallback controller, roadworthiness case or regulatory approval.

comparator_context.caveat: Bench2Drive leaderboard says results are self-reported, from v0.0.3, and methods vary in data, pretraining, experts, compute, parameters and privileges. PDM-Lite is shown in the privileged section and is not a matched vision-only comparator.
Native NAVSIM v2 EPDMS end-to-end test metric. Do not compare directly to Bench2Drive DS or planning-track metrics.
NVIDIA-reported DRIVE AGX Thor deployment recipe and internal comparison, not an independently reproduced Symtropy measurement.
Retrospective company-published operational statistics with location-adjusted human comparisons; distinct from Waymo's formal safety-case process.

tie_handling: All records with identical predicted_failure_probability enter a threshold together. The curve contains one point per unique score. AURC uses a right-continuous step integral over coverage increments.

prospective_targets.note: No driving model has been evaluated by this protocol yet. Targets are protocol acceptance checks, not performance claims.

bootstrap_protocol.replicates: Input declares bootstrap_replicates in [100,10000] and bootstrap_seed
bootstrap_protocol.note: This is a percentile bootstrap interval, not a distribution-free safety guarantee. If a replicate contains no accepted decisions, that replicate is excluded from the accepted-failure-rate interval; the interval is emitted only if all declared replicates are valid. If fewer than two episode clusters exist, all intervals are unavailable.
